Name: Sydney Brown
Badge: Everyday Sparks 2.0
Which strategy from this module (Daily Schedule, Take a Line for a Walk or Interpreting Visual Texts) feels most immediately usable in your teaching context? Why?:

I feel like I would immediately use Take a Line for a Walk in my teaching context. This is a great strategy for my students to gain confidence in their writing, as they are able to freely write what they think.

What other strategies or approaches have you used to engage your students in routine writing over the course of this school year? What, if any, challenges have you encountered in engaging students in sustained routine writing?:
My students have a writing notebook that we use everyday. I also give them 5-10 minutes everyday where they are allowed to free write, this is to help them get comfortable with their writing. I have also used strategies such as journal prompts, quick writes, and creative response avtivites to help students practice writing regulary thoughout the school year. One challenge has been that some student slose motivation or feel frustrated with wriging, especially if they struggle with spelling, grammar, or organizing their ideas.
